items.headline: Oil Prices Surge as Stocks and Bonds Wobble
items.abstract: Crude oil hit its highest levels in months, bond yields continued to rise and stocks fell for a fourth consecutive session as investors worried about energy supplies and inflation.

items.headline: Supreme Court Again Blocks Republican-Backed Missouri Voting Map
items.abstract: The ruling deferred to the state’s Supreme Court, which had invalidated G.O.P.-friendly district lines, saying voters must first have an opportunity to approve the map in a statewide referendum.

items.headline: Dudamel Lands in New York, With Big Ambitions and a Packed Schedule
items.abstract: “This is not a job — it is a mission,” the new conductor of the New York Philharmonic said, starting a month of performances before taking the orchestra on a European tour.

items.headline: Trump’s Trade War With Canada Is Making Even Sprinkle Makers Nervous
items.abstract: President Trump’s levies on a long, eclectic list of products from Canada have companies scrambling to figure out if their supply chains are affected.

items.headline: Jimmy Kimmel Moves Talarico Interview to YouTube Because of F.C.C. ‘Threat’
items.abstract: In a monologue on Wednesday, Mr. Kimmel said that the show made the decision because the F.C.C. had “threatened” ABC over “traditional editorial decisions.”
